name: openlibing-code-metrics-action
description: Code metrics scan plugin - detect code scale, avg function LOC, avg cyclomatic complexity, code duplication rate and file duplication rate

scripts.package: ncc build src/index.ts -o dist && node scripts/normalize-dist.js && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/bin','dist/bin',{recursive:true})"
scripts.all: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package
